exposure: Women with low FOC (W-DEQ sum score ≤60)
outcome: antenatal unit visits due to adverse childbirth experiences
cohort: Women expecting their first child and attending an ordinary antenatal program
finding: Women with severe fear of childbirth generate considerably higher perinatal costs compared to women with low fear of childbirth when handled in standard care.
mod_finding: Women with severe FOC more often had an elective cesarean section on maternal request (p = 0.02) and more seldom had normal spontaneous deliveries (p = 0.03) compared to the group with low FOC.
